about: The Claude models a loop agent may run on. The dashboard's model picker offers exactly these, and every agent workflow checks a picked model against this list before using it: anything not listed here is ignored with a warning and the agent runs on `default`. Ids are Claude Code model aliases, which work on both the Claude subscription and Bedrock. See docs/DASHBOARD-CONTRACT.md section 6.

choices.label: Opus
choices.blurb: The most capable model, and what every agent ran on before this setting existed. Uses the most of your plan's usage limits.

choices.label: Sonnet
choices.blurb: Fast and strong. A good fit for most coding and review work, and lighter on your usage limits.

choices.label: Haiku
choices.blurb: The fastest and lightest. Best for simple, well-defined jobs; noticeably weaker on hard problems.
